messages.content: where can i buy a japanese dwarf flying squirrel

message.content:
If you mean a **live Japanese dwarf flying squirrel**, I can’t help you find a seller, because this species is a wild animal from Japan and the search results do not show any clear, legitimate pet trade source for it.[3] The result you found on Etsy appears to be for a **product or themed listing**, not a live animal.[1]

If you want a **legal pet alternative**, a **licensed exotic breeder** selling **southern flying squirrels** is listed in Texas, with in-person pickup and baby alerts.[2] For a **stuffed animal or model**, Etsy and Wild Republic both have Japanese dwarf flying squirrel items.[1][6]

If you tell me your **country/state**, I can help you check whether a flying squirrel is legal there and point you to safer, lawful options.
